policy.policy_note: Single composition family (sb_undertow, CC BY 4.0) carries the whole film -- one continuous musical backbone with energy automation across the seven editorial sections, including the motion hook and end-card release, not a mandated minimum number of distinct audio files.

full_cues.function: Open on the Chikyu test and the depth descent; the licensed motion hook plays fully unducked from frame zero, then settles into curiosity as narration begins.
full_cues.instrumentation: sub-bass pressure, distant mechanical pulse, sparse sonar-like texture

full_cues.function: Concentration numbers and the 2025 export-control shock; mechanical, procedural pressure.
full_cues.instrumentation: restrained low-mid pulse with slow percussive escalation

full_cues.function: Move from Japan's EEZ to the Clarion-Clipperton Zone; widening, exploratory motion after the chokepoint shock recedes.
full_cues.instrumentation: restrained low-mid pulse with slow percussive escalation

full_cues.function: ISA code and the US parallel route; restrained, document-weighted gravity.
full_cues.instrumentation: restrained low-mid pulse with slow percussive escalation

full_cues.function: The strongest case for extraction, held against its own limits; the film's most persuasive, most energetic argument.
full_cues.instrumentation: restrained low-mid pulse with slow percussive escalation

full_cues.function: Track, biodiversity, plume and midwater evidence; the argument's energy recedes hard into controlled, somber unease, never sensational.
full_cues.instrumentation: restrained low-mid pulse with slow percussive escalation

full_cues.function: Governance, distributed risk and the closing line; wide, unresolved ambience continues through the full end-card release so the film never drops its tonal world prematurely.
full_cues.instrumentation: wide unresolved ambience, no resolution chord
full_cues.transition_out: long release to silence at the exact film end
